towns.name: Emberfall
towns.description: A lantern-lit settlement built around a warm shard spring.

facilities.name: Cinderstock Exchange
facilities.description: A brass-shuttered supply shop for trail gear and shard-safe provisions.

facilities.name: The Quiet Wick
facilities.description: A spring-warmed inn where travelers can recover before entering the wilds.

facilities.name: Wayfinder Assembly
facilities.description: A public expedition hall that records hazards and matches crews to contracts.

facilities.name: Prismwake Square
facilities.description: The central square for notices, orientation, and safe-route announcements.

facilities.name: The Copper Comet
facilities.description: A bright cellar tavern where scouts exchange verified rumors over ember tea.

hunting_grounds.name: Mossreach Wilds
hunting_grounds.description: Rain-bright terraces where glasshorn hares and reed wolves roam.

floors.name: Echo Gallery
floors.description: Resonant halls patrolled by clay sentries.

floors.name: Flooded Archive
floors.description: Half-submerged records watched by ink eels.

floors.name: Nightglass Causeway
floors.description: A narrow bridge crossed by drifting mirror moths.

floors.name: Hushed Reservoir
floors.description: Still cisterns conceal pressure locks and pale shellbacks.

floors.name: Sable Orrery
floors.description: Unlit brass planets rotate around a cold artificial moon.

floors.name: Gloam Workshop
floors.description: Abandoned lens-cutters continue their dangerous programmed motions.

floors.name: Ashen Conservatory
floors.description: Black-leaf vines thrive beneath lamps that shed no warmth.

floors.name: Inverted Belfry
floors.description: A descending bell tower rings when intruders step on false stairs.

floors.name: Crownless Antechamber
floors.description: Nine sealed doors open only when their reflected symbols align.

floors.name: Chamber of the Null Cartographer
floors.description: A round map chamber defended by a construct that erases every path it measures.

completion.unlock_description: The defeated cartographer restores the Aurora Lift, opening an original route to world floor 2.
